title: 🐢 Chaos Cubed / Tiny Takeover
author: Jonathan Hill
excerpt: Silver Springs Survival has officially updated to 26.2, introducing the Chaos Cubed and Tiny Takeover game drops! Explore newly regenerated resource worlds, discover sulfur caves and cubes, and enjoy updated baby mobs alongside several SSS-specific improvements. This update also includes numerous technical changes and fixes to keep everything running smoothly.
body:
Hey everyone. The server is (finally!) updated to 26.2, which covers the Chaos Cubed and Tiny Takeover game drops.

  • 🧊Chaos Cubed adds a new sulfur cave biome and their sulfur cube inhabitants who can be fed certain blocks to become different physics objects.

  • 🐥Tiny Takeover remodels all baby animals, makes name tags craftable, and adds the golden dandelion, which can keep mobs as babies forever!

SSS has the following supporting and miscellaneous updates:

  • 🌎The resource world has been regenerated. Go find some sulfur caves!

  • 🧊Sulfur cubes of the smallest size can drop a Sulfur Cube Head.

  • 🎶The new Bounce music disc is playable in Walkman.

  • 🏷️The server shop no longer buys name tags, as they are cheaply craftable.

  • 😁Happy Ghasts you've protected (such as by naming them) can now be used with Impetus of Artemis.

  • 💍Added /charm info to view info about a charm. This covers all charms, not just the Valor Shop ones.

  • 🥔Poisonous potatoes can no longer be given to babies to prevent their growth. Use the golden dandelion!

There were a ton of technical changes to the game behind the scenes for these updates, which contributed to the delays and required a number of updates from me to stabilize. If you notice anything behaving oddly (especially particles or in-game text from commands), please let me know.

Cheers!
